description.value: Studio Connexion Art Gallery is a community art gallery in Nakusp, BC, showcasing local artists through rotating exhibitions including summer and winter group shows. Located in the Kootenays, it is now in its 18th Summer Exhibition Series, suggesting an established presence in this small Arrow Lakes town. A touring cyclist passing through Nakusp could stop in to experience regional visual arts in a gallery-sized venue.
